channel.desc: Journeying across France, Dave and Si explore the 'bouchon', a restaurant traditionally run by a female chef or 'm?re Lyonnaise'. As for their own efforts, they start with a tarte aux pralines and create a saucisson-stuffed brioche. After a quick stop to learn the secrets of teeth-pulling nougat in Mont?limar, they go truffle-hunting for the famous white summer truffle.
